TOOLING BURST T-freeze — HITL Run C-2 step 3: commit the ruled bands, regenerate the dope sheets + pose guides from the committed rows, add the bible style + bands cards (schema v0.3). task_id "T-freeze". Rulings: ledger R-29 (Matt, C-2 sheet R-a…R-h accepted), R-23 (H1 register), R-28.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 4 (bible schema), § 6 rows T1b/T1c.
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md
3. oracle/bands_idle.json, oracle/bands_walk.json, oracle/dope_sheet.py, oracle/pose_guide.py, gates/idle_intent.py, gates/gait_intent.py (all READ ONLY), bible/schema.json, bible/f04-keepers.json, bible/validate.py, tests/test_bible.py, tests/test_dope_sheet.py, tests/oracles_helpers.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY.

DO, in this order, and report every number in the receipt concerns:

(1) oracle/bands_idle.json — edit IN PLACE (json, keep key order where possible; never delete a key — supersede):
  row "combat": set "committed": true; "lock_regions": ["hips","legs","feet","arms_left","arms_right"]; "motion_regions": ["shoulders_chest","head"]; "moving_count": 2; add "lock_eps_H": 0.004; add "region_lists_source": "ruling R-29 (R-b) 2026-09-12 — set by ruling; the T1b displacement classifier returned all-LOCK on this oracle clip". Leave breath_amplitude_H (floor 0.03916764 / target 0.06527941 / ceiling 0.09791911) and head_sway_H (0.03279878 / 0.05466464 / 0.08199695) EXACTLY as they are; leave breath_period_s null.
  row "relaxed": the current row is the Hades House clip measurement (breath 0.0021 H; contamination 0.45; below resolution per T1a-idle-2) and is SUPERSEDED. Move its measurement keys (breath_amplitude_H, head_sway_H, contamination, provenance, result, summary, curves, void_frames, lock_regions, motion_regions, moving_count) verbatim under a new key "superseded_house_measurement" (lineage; nothing deleted). Then set the row's live keys: "breath_amplitude_H": {"floor": 0.01958382, "target": 0.03263970, "ceiling": 0.04895956} (= 0.6 / 1.0 / 1.5 × (0.5 × combat target 0.06527941) — compute from the combat row, do not paste); "head_sway_H": {"floor": 0.0, "target": 0.006, "ceiling": 0.012} (Legolas I-3: head ≤ 1.2 %H and ≤ chest; the '≤ chest' clause is NOT enforceable by the frozen gate — say so in concerns); "breath_period_s": 2.0; "lock_regions": ["hips","legs","feet","arms_left","arms_right"]; "motion_regions": ["shoulders_chest"] (head is in NEITHER list: its band governs); "moving_count": 1; "lock_eps_H": 0.004; "committed": true; "provisional": true; "provenance": {"rule": "R-29 (R-c) 2026-09-12: provisional = 0.5 × committed combat breath; head band per Legolas R10 § 5.4 I-3; period per Legolas § 2.3 relaxed-idle norm 2.0 s (16 f @ 8 fps)", "derived_from_row": "combat", "superseded_measurement": "Hades relaxed House clip — 0.21 %H, contamination 0.45, below resolution (T1a-idle-2)"}; "contamination": null; "void_frames": [].
  Then verify: python3 -c import of bible/validate is not needed here, but DO run gates.idle_intent.evaluate is NOT possible without frames — instead assert by loading the JSON that both rows have committed true and the exact numbers above (print them).

(2) oracle/bands_walk.json — edit IN PLACE, row "plate13_lateral_ann" ONLY: "bands"."parameters"."k_vert": 1.25; "bands"."W1"."target" = W1 value × 1.25 (expected 0.04932338 from value 0.03945871); "bands"."W1"."ceiling": 0.07 (rule R-e: 1.5 × target = 0.07399 would exceed the stated per-gate ceiling 0.07, so the stated ceiling holds — record both numbers in a new key "bands"."W1"."ceiling_note"); "bands"."W1"."floor" unchanged (0.03945871, the Muybridge plate 13 lateral measurement); "committed": true; add top-level row key "commit_note": "R-29 (R-a/R-e) 2026-09-12 — RULES commit: annotation-path W4 value 4 and W6 value 0.5417 disagree with the rules (2 / 0.75) at mean confidence 0.76 while the mask path agrees (2 / 1.0); disclosed, not hidden. Only this row is committed; plate13_lateral (mask), plate13_front, plate13_rear, plate2_lateral stay report-only.". Do NOT re-run oracle/walk_bands.py (it would rewrite provenance across rows). Do not touch any other row.

(3) Regenerate from the COMMITTED rows with the frozen tools (python3 - <<'PY' scripts that only import oracle.dope_sheet / oracle.pose_guide; run from the burst root so the package imports resolve):
  runs/C-1/oracle/dope_walk_12.json + .txt = dope_sheet.walk_sheet(row 'plate13_lateral_ann', n_frames=12); .txt = the sheet's prompt_text exactly as T1b wrote it.
  runs/C-1/oracle/pose_guides/walk_00.png … walk_11.png = pose_guide.render_walk_guide(that sheet, H_px=400) (overwrite).
  runs/C-1/oracle/dope_idle_relaxed_16.json + .txt = dope_sheet.idle_sheet(row 'relaxed', n_frames=16, fps=8).
  runs/C-1/oracle/dope_idle_combat_8.json + .txt = idle_sheet('combat', 8, 12); dope_idle_combat_16.json + .txt = idle_sheet('combat', 16, 8) (overwrite).
  Report, per sheet: the count of lines beginning "INTENT CONFLICT" in the .txt (expected 0 everywhere; if not 0, quote the line and do not suppress it), the period_source, and for the walk the W1 target printed in the sheet.

(4) Bible schema v0.3 — bible/schema.json: add two OPTIONAL top-level properties (additionalProperties stays false; required unchanged):
  "style": {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"register_id":{"type":"string"},"ruling":{"type":"string"},"sentence":{"type":"string"},"screen":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"default_world_language":{"type":"string"},"level_dialect":{"type":"string"},"character_height_frac_1080p":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}}},"exhibits":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string"},"sha256":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"},"role":{"type":"string"}}}}}}
  "bands": {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"idle":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string"},"sha256":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"},"committed_rows":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}},"walk":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"path":{"type":"string"},"sha256":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"},"committed_rows":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}}}}
  Update the schema "title" to say v0.3. Use only keywords bible/validate.py supports (it raises on unknown keywords).
  bible/f04-keepers.json — add:
  "style": {"register_id":"H1","ruling":"R-23 (Q74) 2026-09-12; re-frozen at C-2 step 3 (R-29)","sentence":"HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration.","screen":{"default_world_language":"ARPG-language world: ~45° camera, cold key, warm accents only — the classic isometric-ARPG band (D2R / GD / PoE / LE corpus centre)","level_dialect":"Hades-language framing (steep ~60° arena, bold ground pattern, jewel-toned light) — a level dialect inside H1, never the default","character_height_frac_1080p":0.17},"exhibits":[…]} where exhibits = these six files with their sha256 (compute; role text as given): runs/C-1/artifacts/K4-gen-H1/k4_H1_1.png + k4_H1_2.png (role "figure exhibit — evidence of the ruled register; NOT a generation reference"), runs/C-1/artifacts/K6-male-H1/k6_male_H1_1.png + k6_male_H1_2.png (role "in-world figure exhibit; NOT a generation reference"), runs/C-1/artifacts/K7-H1-foundry/k7_H1_foundry.png + runs/C-1/artifacts/K7-H1-aery/k7_H1_aery.png (role "room exhibit, Hades-language dialect; NOT a generation reference"). Paths relative to the burst root.
  "bands": {"idle":{"path":"oracle/bands_idle.json","sha256":<sha256 of the file AFTER step 1>,"committed_rows":["combat","relaxed"]},"walk":{"path":"oracle/bands_walk.json","sha256":<sha256 AFTER step 2>,"committed_rows":["plate13_lateral_ann"]}}.
  Run bible/validate.py on f04-keepers.json → must return []. Add to tests/test_bible.py ONE test: the v0.3 optional keys validate on the stub, a wrong-shaped 'bands' fails, and the existing extra-key rejection still holds.

(5) Write astra_test_01/burst/.gitignore with two lines: __pycache__/ and tests/tmp/ (R-28; the conductor handles git).

(6) Run the FULL suite: cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py — expected all green except the five named standing reds (four T0-d3; the walk grid-parity red); report exact counts (tests_run / successful).

DO NOT touch: lane/, gates/, oracles/, parts/, compare/, transcribe/, review/, oracle/*.py (read only — only the two JSON band files change), SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, briefs/, fixtures/, bible/f04-keepers.stub.json. Under runs/ write ONLY runs/C-1/oracle/. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T-freeze"): files with sha256 (both band files, both bible files, the .gitignore, every regenerated sheet/guide, the test file); images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns with the numbers from (1)–(6). Never PASS/FAIL.
